name: Coffeetable
description:
Looking for book recommendations?
Coffeetable helps you find your next book.

Say what you just finished, a mood you are in, or a situation you are stuck in, and Coffeetable names two or three real books 

You choose your next book from the author's own writing from public previews, instead of just getting a name from claude

_published_faq.name: How do I add Coffeetable to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Coffeetable to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://claude-mcp.coffeetable.kushalsm.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Coffeetable MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Coffeetable provides these MCP tools: coffeetable_find_books, coffeetable_grep_book, coffeetable_read_pages, and coffeetable_render.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Coffeetable?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Coffeetable in media-entertainment on the Manufact MCP catalog include Credits.fm, SceneF, HANKOOKILBO MCP, Ticketbox.vn, and drawnames.
Coffeetable requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Coffeetable is developed by Kushal SM. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
